headline: Planview Recognized by Gartner® as a Leader in Adaptive Project Management and Reporting
summary: AUSTIN, Texas, August 06, 2026--Planview®, the leading platform that equips organizations to act decisively and close the gap between strategic intent and outcomes, today announced that it has been named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Adaptive Project Management and Reporting (APMR)1. This is the fifth consecutive year that Planview has been recognized as a Leader and was positioned among organizations for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute.
